arStrings.szText: This Mega Bundle includes "Beauty in Sin" Rogue equipment, "Sins of the Flesh" Necromancer equipment, "Sins of Wrath" Barbarian equipment, "Sins of Ambition" Sorcerer equipment, "Sins of Agony" Spiritborn equipment, "Sins of Wanton Delights" Paladin equipment, and "Sins of Desecration" Warlock equipment.
